channel: Catholic Minute - Catholic speaker Ken Yasinski
description:
Helping people live the Catholic life. We are a Catholic couple, raising a family of 8 young children, producing videos on living the Catholic spiritual life. Our faith topics include Jesus, Mary, the Sacraments, prayer, the Saints, the virtues, and devotional prayers: all focused on striving to live a life of holiness please to God. 

Our videos and special retreat series follow the liturgical life of the Catholic Church. We seek always to remain faithful to the deposit of faith and the official magisterial teaching of the Catholic Church. Our hope is to become saints one day and help others do the same. Let’s journey together. 

You will also find on this Catholic channel many traditional Catholic prayers: the Holy Rosary (all mysteries),  St Bridget prayers, Novenas, Chaplets and traditional daily prayers.
